25476.subject: Physics
25476.question_text: A pendulum bob executing simple harmonic motion has 2cm and 12Hz as amplitude and frequency respectively. Calculate the period of the motion.
25476.explanation:
Given:
- Frequency \( f = 12 \, \text{Hz} \)

The period \( T \) is the reciprocal of the frequency:
\(T = \frac{1}{f}\)

Substituting the given frequency:
\(T = \frac{1}{12 \, \text{Hz}} \approx 0.0833 \, \text{s}\)

Thus, the period of the motion is approximately:
\(T \approx 0.08 \, \text{s}\).

The angle of incidence i = 20º, Rotation of the mirror = 2 x 20º = 40º, Then the new angle of incidence i after rotation of mirror = 20º + 40º

But, angle of reflection r = angle of incidence i ( law of reflection)

Therefore, the angle between the incident ray and the reflected ray = i + r = 60º + 60º = 120º
